package onboarding

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

// HandoffWorker advances one durable boundary at a time: Planner acceptance
// is committed before the idempotent Dialog notification is attempted.
type HandoffWorker struct {
	Store           repository.TeacherOnboardingHandoffStore
	Planner         repository.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffGateway
	Readiness       repository.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver
	Responses       repository.DialogTeacherResponseAppender
	Proactive       repository.DialogTeacherProactiveAppender
	ChannelDelivery repository.TelegramDeliveryEnqueuer
	IDs             IDGenerator
	Clock           Clock
	WorkerID        string
	LeaseTTL        time.Duration
	RetryBaseDelay  time.Duration
	RetryMaxDelay   time.Duration
	MaxAttempts     int

	// lastClaimWasNotification provides bounded fairness between the two
	// independent ledger queues. A notification still wins the first eligible
	// pass (important for a dense source cursor), but a continuing notification
	// backlog cannot indefinitely prevent READY handoffs from reaching Planner.
	lastClaimWasNotification bool
}

func (worker *HandoffWorker) ProcessNext(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
	if !worker.valid() {
		return false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable
	}
	now := worker.Clock.Now().UTC()
	if !worker.lastClaimWasNotification {
		if claimed, err := worker.claimNotification(ctx, now); err != nil || claimed {
			return claimed, err
		}
		return worker.claimDispatch(ctx, now)
	}
	if claimed, err := worker.claimDispatch(ctx, now); err != nil || claimed {
		return claimed, err
	}
	return worker.claimNotification(ctx, now)
}

func (worker *HandoffWorker) claimDispatch(ctx context.Context, now time.Time) (bool, error) {
	claimToken := worker.IDs.NewID()
	intent, claimed, err := worker.Store.ClaimDispatch(ctx, claimToken, worker.WorkerID, now, now.Add(worker.LeaseTTL))
	if err != nil || !claimed {
		return claimed, err
	}
	worker.lastClaimWasNotification = false
	return true, worker.dispatch(ctx, intent)
}

func (worker *HandoffWorker) claimNotification(ctx context.Context, now time.Time) (bool, error) {
	claimToken := worker.IDs.NewID()
	intent, claimed, err := worker.Store.ClaimNotification(ctx, claimToken, worker.WorkerID, now, now.Add(worker.LeaseTTL))
	if err != nil || !claimed {
		return claimed, err
	}
	worker.lastClaimWasNotification = true
	return true, worker.notify(ctx, intent)
}

func (worker HandoffWorker) dispatch(ctx context.Context, intent domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) error {
	result, err := worker.Planner.CreateOnboardingPlanHandoff(ctx, intent)
	if err == nil {
		return worker.Store.MarkAccepted(ctx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, result, worker.Clock.Now().UTC())
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffActivePath) || errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffStateChanged) {
		readiness, resolveErr := worker.Readiness.ResolveLearningReadiness(ctx, intent.StudentID, intent.StateRef)
		if resolveErr == nil {
			readiness, resolveErr = domain.NormalizeTeacherLearningReadiness(readiness, &intent.StateRef)
		}
		if resolveErr == nil && readiness.Result == domain.TeacherLearningReadinessNotReady && readiness.ReasonCodes[0] == domain.TeacherReadinessReasonActivePathExists {
			return worker.Store.MarkActivePath(ctx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, worker.Clock.Now().UTC())
		}
		if resolveErr == nil {
			return errors.Join(err, worker.Store.Block(ctx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, "planner_state_changed", worker.Clock.Now().UTC()))
		}
		if errors.Is(resolveErr, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessStale) {
			return errors.Join(err, resolveErr, worker.Store.Block(ctx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, "student_state_stale", worker.Clock.Now().UTC()))
		}
		return worker.retryDispatch(ctx, intent, "planner_reconcile_unavailable", errors.Join(err, resolveErr))
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict) {
		return errors.Join(err, worker.Store.Block(ctx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, "planner_handoff_conflict", worker.Clock.Now().UTC()))
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffRejected) {
		return errors.Join(err, worker.Store.Block(ctx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, "planner_handoff_rejected", worker.Clock.Now().UTC()))
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse) {
		return errors.Join(err, worker.Store.Block(ctx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, "planner_response_invalid", worker.Clock.Now().UTC()))
	}
	return worker.retryDispatch(ctx, intent, "planner_handoff_unavailable", err)
}

func (worker HandoffWorker) notify(ctx context.Context, intent domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) error {
	displayName, err := domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffDisplayName(intent.Goal)
	if err != nil {
		return errors.Join(err, worker.Store.Block(ctx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, "handoff_goal_invalid", worker.Clock.Now().UTC()))
	}
	body := domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffActivePathBody(intent.Locale)
	if intent.PlannerHandoffID != "" {
		body, err = domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffAcceptedBody(intent.Locale, displayName)
		if err != nil {
			return errors.Join(err, worker.Store.Block(ctx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, "handoff_copy_invalid", worker.Clock.Now().UTC()))
		}
	}
	var message domain.DialogMessage
	if intent.SourceRequest != nil {
		message, err = worker.Responses.AppendTeacherResponse(ctx, *intent.SourceRequest, intent.NotificationCommandID, body)
		if err == nil {
			message, err = domain.NewDialogTeacherResponse(*intent.SourceRequest, message)
		}
	} else {
		binding, bindingErr := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
			ID: intent.DialogID, StudentID: intent.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: intent.PersonalTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
		})
		if bindingErr != nil {
			return errors.Join(bindingErr, worker.Store.Block(ctx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, "dialog_binding_invalid", worker.Clock.Now().UTC()))
		}
		message, err = worker.Proactive.AppendTeacherProactive(ctx, binding, intent.NotificationCommandID, body)
		if err == nil {
			message, err = domain.NewDialogTeacherProactive(binding, message)
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return worker.retryNotification(ctx, intent, "dialog_notification_unavailable", err)
	}
	if message.Body != body {
		return errors.Join(domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext, worker.Store.Block(ctx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, "dialog_notification_invalid", worker.Clock.Now().UTC()))
	}
	if intent.SourceRequest != nil && message.Channel == domain.DialogMessageChannelTelegram {
		if worker.ChannelDelivery == nil {
			return worker.retryNotification(ctx, intent, "telegram_delivery_unavailable", domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable)
		}
		if err := worker.ChannelDelivery.EnqueueDelivery(ctx, intent.SourceRequest.SourceMessageID, intent.StudentID, body, worker.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return worker.retryNotification(ctx, intent, "telegram_delivery_unavailable", err)
		}
	}
	return worker.Store.MarkDelivered(ctx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, message.ID, worker.Clock.Now().UTC())
}

func (worker HandoffWorker) retryDispatch(ctx context.Context, intent domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, code string, cause error) error {
	now := worker.Clock.Now().UTC()
	durableCtx := context.WithoutCancel(ctx)
	if intent.Attempts >= worker.MaxAttempts {
		return errors.Join(cause, worker.Store.Block(durableCtx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, code+"_exhausted", now))
	}
	return errors.Join(cause, worker.Store.RetryDispatch(durableCtx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, code, now.Add(worker.retryDelay(intent.Attempts)), now))
}

func (worker HandoffWorker) retryNotification(ctx context.Context, intent domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, code string, cause error) error {
	now := worker.Clock.Now().UTC()
	durableCtx := context.WithoutCancel(ctx)
	if intent.Attempts >= worker.MaxAttempts {
		return errors.Join(cause, worker.Store.Block(durableCtx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, code+"_exhausted", now))
	}
	return errors.Join(cause, worker.Store.RetryNotification(durableCtx, intent.ID, intent.ClaimToken, code, now.Add(worker.retryDelay(intent.Attempts)), now))
}

func (worker HandoffWorker) retryDelay(attempt int) time.Duration {
	if attempt < 1 {
		attempt = 1
	}
	delay := worker.RetryBaseDelay
	for current := 1; current < attempt && delay < worker.RetryMaxDelay; current++ {
		if delay > worker.RetryMaxDelay/2 {
			return worker.RetryMaxDelay
		}
		delay *= 2
	}
	if delay > worker.RetryMaxDelay {
		return worker.RetryMaxDelay
	}
	return delay
}

func (worker HandoffWorker) valid() bool {
	return worker.Store != nil && worker.Planner != nil && worker.Readiness != nil && worker.Responses != nil && worker.Proactive != nil &&
		worker.IDs != nil && worker.Clock != nil && worker.WorkerID != "" && worker.LeaseTTL > 0 && worker.RetryBaseDelay > 0 &&
		worker.RetryMaxDelay >= worker.RetryBaseDelay && worker.MaxAttempts > 0
}
